about_the_game:
🧪 Fracctal TCG: Demo

Fuse Pokémon-style creatures with Hearthstone-inspired combat in this fast, strategic card battler.
Try out the Fracctal TCG Demo and experience the core mechanics that power this elemental deck-building experience. Build 30-card decks, evolve your monsters mid-battle, and outsmart opponents in quick, tactical duels.

🎮 What’s in the Demo?

This playable demo gives you early access to the heart of Fracctal TCG. All listed features below are available to test and enjoy right now:

  • 🔥 Elemental Deck Building
    Choose from eight elemental teams—like Fire, Ice, Plant, Rock, Psychic, Electric, and more. Master mono-element decks or blend types for clever combos.

  • ⚔️ Hearthstone-Inspired Combat System
    Start with 2 mana, gain +1 each turn (up to 10). With tight resource curves and 20 HP heroes, every card matters. No slow snowballing—games are won in under 10 minutes.

  • 🧬 Mid-Match Card Evolution
    Let a creature survive three of your turns and watch it evolve into a stronger form. Protect key units and turn the tide.

  • 🧠 Hero Powers ("Fairy Skills")
    Each elemental hero has a unique once-per-turn ability. Deal damage, heal allies, stall enemies, or fortify your defenses—timing is everything.

  • 🎯 Game Modes Included

    • Tutorial Mode – Learn the fundamentals with a guided walkthrough.

    • Solo Mode – Practice against the AI to master new archetypes.

    • Ranked PvP Ladder – Climb using skill-based ELO matchmaking.

    • Automated Tournaments – Enter daily or weekly bracketed events for big in-game currency rewards.
      (Tournaments run automatically through our backend—no need to coordinate.)

  • 🎁 Progression System
    Win matches and complete daily quests to earn currency and level up your favorite cards or unlock new strategies.

🔑 Key Demo Features

  • 30-card decks, 20 HP heroes, and tight match pacing

  • 8 elemental teams with unique synergies

  • Minions that evolve mid-battle

  • Unique hero powers per element

  • Full progression and card leveling system

  • Solo, Ranked, and Tournament modes

  • Built-in tutorial for new players

Whether you're a competitive card game veteran or just discovering the genre, the Fracctal TCG Demo offers a deep, fast-paced experience designed to hook you from the first match.

Play the demo now—and start building your elemental legacy.
